name: Otwocki Łomot
summary: Otwocki Łomot is a comic-book beat 'em up in the style of 90s arcade cabinets, set in the real Polish town of Otwock. Someone kidnapped Ciapek, the dog of Kuba "Rudy" Sosnowski, and he isn't waiting for the police. Fight through a detective campaign of a prologue and 15 chapters across real places - the railway station, the market on Batorego Street, a rainy football stadium, the Świder river beach - all redrawn as comic panels. Grab bats, bricks and benches, buy new moves at the kiosk, fill the Rage bar, question witnesses and track the dog down. Free demo; the full game is unlocked with a one-time purchase, no ads.
